user.title: Connect to your Vanderbilt SPC panel
user.description: Enable EDP in the panel’s global settings, then add a receiver pointing to this Home Assistant host. Use that receiver’s ID, TCP port and encryption key below.

data.encryption_key: EDP encryption key (32 hex digits, optional)

data_description.receiver_id: Identifies Home Assistant’s receiver entry on the panel (1–999997). The separate EDP Panel ID identifies the alarm panel.
data_description.port: Match Receiver IP Port in the panel’s receiver entry (default 50000).
data_description.bind: Home Assistant’s local listen address. Keep 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.
data_description.encryption_key: Leave blank if EDP encryption is disabled on the panel.

reconfigure.title: Update your Vanderbilt SPC panel connection
reconfigure.description: Update the matching receiver entry on the panel when changing these settings. Home Assistant restarts its listener after saving.

data.encryption_key: EDP encryption key (32 hex digits, optional)

data_description.receiver_id: Identifies Home Assistant’s receiver entry on the panel (1–999997). The separate EDP Panel ID identifies the alarm panel.
data_description.port: Match Receiver IP Port in the panel’s receiver entry (default 50000).
data_description.bind: Home Assistant’s local listen address. Keep 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.
data_description.encryption_key: Leave blank if EDP encryption is disabled on the panel.

error.invalid_receiver_id: Receiver ID must be a whole number between 1 and 999997.
error.invalid_port: Port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_encryption_key: The encryption key must be exactly 32 hex digits (16 bytes), or left blank.
error.cannot_bind: Could not bind to that address and port. It may already be in use.

abort.already_configured: A receiver is already configured for that bind address and port.

data_description.idle_timeout: Disconnect the panel if it sends nothing for this long. The panel typically polls every ~10 seconds.
data_description.area_refresh_interval: A slower full re-sync of areas/zones to correct for any drift not covered by pushed events.
data_description.reconnect_grace: Keep the last known state this long while the panel redials its EDP link, which it does several times a day. Commands are refused until it is back. 0 marks entities unavailable immediately.
